name: Tension build
description: A build-up and drop. Over the last bars of the current song a resonant high-pass filter climbs, stripping away its bass so it gets thinner and more urgent, and an echo swells on its final bars; then it stops dead and the next song drops in, beat-matched, on the downbeat. Big and showy: use it into songs that start with a beat or hit hard straight away, and where the energy goes up.
author: Muisc
